figures.label: Learning visual
figures.alt: Six symbols form a numbered route: task sheet and question mark; quantities and units under a magnifying glass; connected links; calculator; checking balance; and chart inside a speech bubble. They represent identifying the task, finding mathematical information, connecting information, applying methods and tools, interpreting and evaluating, and sharing the result and its meaning. A red return arrow links checking back to the original task.

svg.title: Project 2 station activities and individual tablet turns
svg.description: Every pair needs a 20-minute tablet activity and a 20-minute printed activity. The activities may run at the same time for different pairs. Within a tablet station block, learner 1 controls the device for ten minutes, learner 2 controls it for ten minutes, and five minutes remain for checking, saving and moving. Ten plus ten plus five makes a 25-minute block. This concept schematic does not supply the changed seven-pair rotation or resource calculations.
